title: Corpus precision via exhaustive scopes
description: Compute real precision on benchmark corpus repos by declaring exhaustive file scopes in annotations. Extra scanner hits in those files are false positives without a per-repo negative.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Extra data_item fill from existing packet includes is on dataparade-cli main (ff6cfd4). Canonical accepted positives: components 519, data_flows 419, pii_signals 325, data_items 302.
